title: Composite pro-etale coefficient identification
statement:
Let $Z\xrightarrow{h}W\xrightarrow{k}V$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with their small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and inverse-image functors [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $R_V,R_W,R_Z$ be sheaves of commutative rings on those sites and fix isomorphisms $c_k:k^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_W$ and $c_h:h^{-1}R_W\xrightarrow{\sim}R_Z$. Define the composite coefficient identification by
$$c_{hk}:(kh)^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}h^{-1}k^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{h^{-1}(c_k)}h^{-1}R_W\xrightarrow{c_h}R_Z.$$
The first arrow is the canonical inverse-image composition comparison [def-per-proetale-ring-inverse-image-comparisons], adjoint to fibre-product pasting on the direct images; no independent identification for the composite is chosen.

def proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients
    {V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (h : Z ⟶ W) (k : W ⟶ V)
    (R_V : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_W : Sheaf (ProEt.topology W) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (R_Z : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c_k : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage k CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_V ≅ R_W)
    (c_h : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage h CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_W ≅ R_Z) :
    (proEtaleSheafInverseImage (h ≫ k) CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R_V ≅ R_Z
